The Drunk Elephant O-Bloos Rosi Drops gifted by Drunk Elephant are an easy to use liquid blush. As someone with fair-light, neutral skin this gives a very light pink flush that looks natural. I used these by dotting a small amount across my cheeks and using my fingers to blend out. I tried with a brush as well, and both methods had great results that looked seamless and did not disturb my foundation underneath. This has a luminous finish that is smooth on the skin and does not enhance any lines or settle into pores the way powder formulas do. This shade is quite sheer and while I did try adding extra layers to build up the intensity, the result is still quite natural and I would not be the best option for those who want a noticably blushed look. Since the pigmentation is so light, I also would recommend trying these in a store, if possible, to see if they would work for your skin tone. I did not experience redness or irritation from this product on my somewhat sensitive skin. These Rosi Drops work great on my dry skin and I am happy to add them into my daily routine.

avis.titre: Minimal/clean girl makeup with a learning curve
avis.texte: This product was gifted by drunkelephant in exchange for my honest review: Don't call it a blush! This is a lovely complexion product you can count on to provide your skin with a luminous flush. The shade is very natural which makes it ideal for clean/minimal makeup days. The formula is quite sheer to the point that it took me some time to figure out how best to apply it. Too little and there was barely any color payoff, but if I added enough to get some pigment going, my cheeks would end up dewier than I prefer. I had to work with the product for awhile to figure out the amount required to find a good balance.

If you're looking for a product to try from Drunk Elephant, it should be these O-Bloos Rosi drops! They are extremely versatile. I like to use them on top of makeup as blush to add some color, but you can also add them to moisturizer or face oil. The color they give off is super natural with a subtle glow, but I can also easily build up the color for more pigment if I want. I always get so many compliments on my skin when I'm wearing these drops. They just make my skin look so healthy..the perfect sunkissed flush! The ingredients are great and the packaging is also adorable and perfect to travel with. 10/10! Gifted by Drunkelephant.

avis.texte: ve been trying out the Drunk Elephant Rosi Glow Drops, and I'm really impressed by how gentle they feel on my skin. It is almost like a hybrid of skincare and makeup. As someone with sensitive skin, the complete lack of scent is perfect for me. It gives my cheeks this beautifully innocent, natural-looking rosy flush, perfect for no-makeup days. It's not at all harsh or artificial, just a lovely, healthy color. The subtle shimmer is gorgeous too, giving my cheeks a really pretty glow. Application is so easy with just my fingertips. My only wish is that the bottle was a little bigger because I can see myself using this all the time! Gifted by drunkelephant
